Everyone says “Buy the Dip.”
But does timing the market actually beat a boring SIP?
We tested it using 25 years of Nifty TRI data — covering the dot-com crash, 2008 financial crisis, demonetisation, COVID, and everything in between.
In this video, we compare:
• A disciplined SIP investor
vs
• A “Buy the Dip” investor waiting for market crashes
And the results were… surprising.
